english.title: Fire upon a vehicle in the service of HM while it was engaged in the prevention of smuggling
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) fired upon a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE..) in the service of His Majesty while it was engaged in the prevention of smuggling
english.legislation: Contrary to section 85(2) of the Customs and Excise Management Act 1979.

english.notes:
(i) For offences committed on or before 30th December 2020 see offence wording document H14379 (CJS code CE79060).
(ii) Section 10 of the Interpretation Act 1978 states that any reference to the Sovereign reigning at the time of the passing of the Act is to be construed, unless the contrary intention appears, as a reference to the Sovereign for the time being. As such, references to ‘Her Majesty’ and ‘the Queen’ have been replaced in the wording of the offences to state ‘His Majesty’ or ‘the King’, although this may not be the strict wording of the legislation.
